summary: Lumenworks: request route-scoped quantization controls for batch summarization (enable only on specific routes/workloads)
description:
Issue summary
- Lumenworks (enterprise, Dedicated) requests the ability to enable quantization ONLY for their batch summarization workload, without impacting interactive chat routes.
- They want route-scoped controls (ideally via Console + API), with canary rollout and fast rollback.

Customer context
- Workload: asynchronous batch summarization of support tickets and call transcripts.
- Separate interactive routes exist for agent-assist chat; customer explicitly does NOT want quantization enabled there due to formatting/tool-calling sensitivity.
- They are cost-sensitive at high volume and are looking for ~20–40% unit cost reduction on summarization if quality holds.

Environment / constraints (per customer)
- Deployment: Redwood Dedicated (prod) in us-east.
- Hardware: currently A100 80GB pool; exploring H100 next quarter but not available yet for their cluster.
- Model policy: must remain pinned to their current model version for interactive routes; summarization route may use approved variants if rollbacks are safe.
- Output requirements: summarization output is free-form text + occasional light structure; interactive routes use strict JSON mode and tool-calling.
- Governance: configuration changes must be auditable (who changed what, when) and reversible.

Requested capabilities
1) Route-scoped quantization enablement (route-level toggle) so only /v1/routes/summarize_batch uses quantized kernels/profile.
2) Canary control (percentage-based) for the route, with ability to ramp and rollback quickly.
3) Visibility/telemetry: confirm at request/trace level whether execution was quantized vs baseline.
4) Safe fallback behavior: if GPU/profile incompatibility occurs, automatically fall back to baseline rather than error.

Support questions / info requested
- Confirm exact route names/IDs in Redwood Console.
- Confirm target models for summarization route and max context lengths.
- Confirm acceptance criteria for regression (they will provide a small prompt set of ~50 examples + format checks).

Impact
- Not an outage. This is a blocker for Lumenworks expanding their usage of Redwood Optimize/quantization features; they will not proceed with quantization if they cannot scope it to non-interactive workloads.

Initial recommendation
- Enroll customer in the Quantization Profile Library beta and use route-level enablement + canary controls (behind feature flag).
- Plan: enable quantization only on summarize_batch route; keep interactive routes baseline.

Notes
- Customer requested an ETA and asked whether this can be configured without request headers (preference: route config in Console/API, not app code changes).

Interactive JSON/tool-calling routes remain baseline. Change scheduled; rollback guidance provided.
